international.title: Campaigners back call for scrutiny of consent laws by Joanne Young
international.summary: Experts say no law states third-party consent is a valid defence and call for public debate and further education Campaigners have welcomed a call for scrutiny of consent laws by a survivor of drug-facilitated rape but said action must also focus on wider issues around sexual assault. Joanne Young , who was drugged and raped by her husband and sexually abused by men he invited into their home, warned of “serious questions about how the law deals with consent”. Continue reading...
